# SOLACE Concierge

> A private concierge service of the Flathead Valley, Montana. SOLACE coordinates the details of a beautifully kept life — dinners, vendor management, household maintenance, lifestyle care — on behalf of vacation guests, second-home owners, families with loved ones in care, and clients in a direct ongoing relationship.

## About

SOLACE Concierge LLC is a founder-led private concierge based in Flathead Valley, Montana, founded January 2026 by Brittany Alcott. SOLACE is a coordination service — it sources, schedules, vets, and follows through with independent licensed and insured Flathead Valley vendors on the client's behalf. SOLACE does not perform the underlying work itself.

- **Service area**: Flathead Valley, Montana — Whitefish, Kalispell, Columbia Falls, Lakeside, Bigfork, and the Glacier National Park corridor.
- **Contact**: contact@solaceconcierge.com · (406) 213-6887 (voice only)
- **Website**: https://solacemontana.com
- **App**: https://solacemt.com
- **Founder**: Brittany Alcott

## Service tiers

- **Solace/Luxury** — Vacation guest concierge for the most discerning Flathead Valley rentals. Distributed through property managers. 48-hour standard lead time. Coordinates pre-arrival prep, dinner reservations, and the small surprises that turn a stay into a memory. https://solacemontana.com/luxury/
- **Solace/Care** — Non-medical lifestyle concierge for families with a loved one in a Flathead Valley care facility. Per-request and subscription pricing. Arranges the visit, the gift, the salon appointment, the birthday cake delivered on the right day. https://solacemontana.com/care/
- **Solace/Home** — Monthly subscription for Flathead homeowners with a second property in the valley. Recurring household management, trusted hands on the maintenance calendar, preparations that make a house feel inhabited even before arrival. https://solacemontana.com/home/
- **Direct to Solace** — The whole-season relationship for full-time and primary residents. By introduction only. A single relationship for every detail of the year: trades, deliveries, household, social calendar, and the things that never make a list. https://solacemontana.com/direct/
- **Solace/Partners** — A curated network of Flathead Valley's most discerning vendors and trades — florists, private chefs, stewards, drivers, craftsmen. Membership by invitation. https://solacemontana.com/partners/

## How pricing works

One flat coordination fee per request, priced by complexity — never by the underlying service. All vendor costs, products, deliveries, rental fees, and gratuities are pass-through: pre-funded by secure invoice before work, then fully itemized after the request is complete. SOLACE does not negotiate vendor rates on the client's behalf, and does not accept gratuities or commissions from vendors.

Standard lead time is 48 hours. Shorter lead times carry rush surcharges: $250 for inside-24-hour requests, $500 for complex same-day requests that move multiple vendors on the day of service.

## Tone and positioning

Quiet luxury. Warm, not cold. Founder-led, relationship-driven. "Aman meets Yellowstone Club" in service philosophy — refined, discreet, and personal. Not over-promising.

## What SOLACE does not do

- Provide medical care, nursing, legal, financial, or fiduciary services
- Replace property managers (works with them, not around them)
- Sell or share client information beyond what a vendor needs for a specific request
- Accept commissions or referral fees from vendors
